description: SPRINGFIELD – State Senator Laura Ellman is advocating for new legislation aimed at banning the use of the toxic herbicide paraquat in Illinois, citing growing evidence linking the chemical to Parkinson’s disease and its mounting impact on families across the state. “Paraquat is one of the most toxic herbicides still in use, and the science linking it to serious health risks …
